question: I thought of birthdays for Caesar and Monet! Caesar is April 9 and Monet is August 27! Is that OK? Ida (TN: Both are puns. 4月 is April. 9日 is Ninth. 4月9日 can be read as "Shinokuni" using Japanese onyomi. Same with Monet. With a bit of effort 8月27日 can be read as "Become a Harpy".)
answer: Yeah, sure. *Hojihoji* (TN: hojihoji is an onomatopoeia for picking your nose. Probably used in this case to signify that he couldn't care less.)
name: Nakamura Ida
